event.lead: The professional cannabis CBD trade show in western France: one day in Nantes for the whole industry.

about.title: What is Cann'Agri Expo?
about.p1: Cann'Agri Expo is the professional trade show for the cannabis CBD industry in western France. For one day in Nantes, growers, distributors, processors, shops and industry experts meet to talk business and discover what's new.
about.p2: The show is run by a non-profit association. Its aim: to give every player in the industry a place to meet, from farmers to laboratories, from specialist shops to project founders.
about.p3: Join us on {date} at {venue} for the 5th edition: exhibitor stands, talks and, to close the day, the Platinum CBD Cup awards.

exhibition.title: The stands
exhibition.description: CBD growers, growing equipment, wellness products, cosmetics, food, accessories: the whole industry, stand after stand.

conferences.title: Talks and round tables
conferences.description: Industry speakers discuss regulation, market trends, growing techniques and the future of the sector.

cup.title: Platinum CBD Cup
cup.description: The competition that rewards the year's best CBD products. A jury of professionals judges and awards the finest creations. Awards ceremony at the end of the day.
